fango 0.1 — :help for commands
> add : Int -> Int -> Int
> Int -> Int -> Int
> 5 : Int
> inc : Int -> Int
> 42 : Int
> <function> : Int -> Int
> fib : Int -> Int
> 55 : Int
> 4 : Int
> -- UNSUPPORTED POLYMORPHISM ----------------------------- <repl>

This expression's type is:

    a -> a

Type variables mean polymorphism, which arrives in S5. Apply it to
concrete arguments instead.

1| \x -> x
   ^^^^^^^
> add : Int -> Int
> 40 : Int
> -- SHADOWING -------------------------------------------- <repl>

The parameter `y` shadows a name that is already defined —
fango does not allow shadowing. Choose a different name.

1| f y y = y
       ^
>
